usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-interest` command (DEC-B14: 1% of the invoice amount, charged once, more than 60 days after the due date), and `help` now lists it right after `run-late-fees`. Charged interest counts in what the invoice and the customer owe; `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 7/7.
One open question is in the report: DEC-B14 doesn't say whether nonprofits pay interest. I assumed they don't, matching the existing rule that nonprofits aren't chased for late payment, so Credit Control should confirm.
The work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
OUTCOME: completed
